items.title: How fast does the error budget actually go?
items.description: Grounded in this unit's checkout example: a 99.9% SLO over a 30-day window allows about 43 minutes of downtime. That budget doesn't drain at a fixed pace — it drains as fast as the current error rate is running. Drag the observed error rate up and watch how quickly the month's entire budget would be gone if that rate kept up — this is the real intuition behind why a fast burn deserves an immediate page even when very little of the budget has technically been spent yet.
items.compute: const allowedFailureRatio = (100 - params.sloTargetPercent) / 100; const observedFailureRatio = params.observedFailureRatePercent / 100; const windowHours = params.windowDays * 24; const burnRate = observedFailureRatio / allowedFailureRatio; const hoursUntilExhausted = windowHours / burnRate; return { hoursUntilExhausted: Math.round(hoursUntilExhausted * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Hours until the whole window's budget is gone, at this rate
